thought.text: Pid file location isn't writable by the `elastic` user. Let me use a pid file inside the ES directory.

reasoning_content: The pidfile at /var/run/elasticsearch.pid is not writable by the elastic user. Use a pidfile within the ES directory instead.

action.command: cd /opt/es && nohup su -s /bin/bash elastic -c "ES_JAVA_OPTS='-Xms1g -Xmx1g' /opt/es/bin/elasticsearch -d -p /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/elasticsearch.pid" > /var/log/es_start.log 2>&1; echo "start exit: $?"; cat /var/log/es_start.log; sleep 10; tail -3 /opt/es/logs/index-data-explorer.log
